```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")

#change age_at_death to "young" for 6 and "old" for 14
animal_metadata$age = case_when(
  animal_metadata$age == "6" ~ "young",
  animal_metadata$age == "14" ~ "old",
  .default = NA
)

```



```{r}
library(readr)
read_percent_per_sample = read_csv("../shared objs and code/10x_html_metrics_summaries/mapping_metrics.csv")
read_percent_per_sample$animal_id = read_percent_per_sample$sample_id %>% as.character() 
read_percent_per_sample = read_percent_per_sample %>% select(-sample_id)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% left_join(read_percent_per_sample, by = "animal_id")
animal_metadata$Reads_Mapped_to_Genome <- as.numeric(gsub("%", "", animal_metadata$`Reads Mapped to Genome`)) / 100
animal_metadata$Reads_Mapped_Confidently_to_Transcriptome <- as.numeric(gsub("%", "", animal_metadata$`Reads Mapped Confidently to Transcriptome`)) / 100
```

```{r}
# ANOVA: genome
anova_genome <- aov(Reads_Mapped_to_Genome ~ strain, data = animal_metadata)
summary(anova_genome)

# ANOVA: transcriptome
anova_transcriptome <- aov(Reads_Mapped_Confidently_to_Transcriptome ~ strain, data = animal_metadata)
summary(anova_transcriptome)
```

```{r}
# pull p-values from the ANOVAs
p_genome <- summary(anova_genome)[[1]]$`Pr(>F)`[1]
p_transcriptome <- summary(anova_transcriptome)[[1]]$`Pr(>F)`[1]

genome_plot = ggplot(animal_metadata, aes(x = strain, y = Reads_Mapped_to_Genome)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(y = "Reads Mapped to Genome (Cellranger Quantification)", x = "Strain",
       subtitle = paste0("ANOVA p = ", signif(p_genome, 3))) +
  ylim(c(.3, 1)) +
  theme_minimal()

transcriptome_plot = ggplot(animal_metadata, aes(x = strain, y = Reads_Mapped_Confidently_to_Transcriptome)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  ylim(c(.3, 1)) +
  labs(y = "Reads Mapped Confidently to Transcriptome (Cellranger Quantification)", x = "Strain",
       subtitle = paste0("ANOVA p = ", signif(p_transcriptome, 3))) +
  theme_minimal()

strain_vis_plot = genome_plot + transcriptome_plot
strain_vis_plot
ggsave("strain alignment visualizations.pdf",strain_vis_plot,width = 20, height = 7)
```
